lessons.title: Longitudes and Latitudes

explanation_sections.title: Longitudes and Latitudes
explanation_sections.body:
Latitude measures angular distance north or south of the Equator; longitude measures east or west of
the Prime Meridian. Approximately 1° latitude = 111 km. At latitude φ, one degree of longitude is
approximately 111 cos φ km.

questions.prompt: Two places on the same meridian are at 10°N and 25°N. Estimate distance.
